title: Hand showers.
officialText:
Hand-held showers shall conform to ASME A112.18.1 or CSA B125.1. Hand-held showers shall provide
backflow protection in accordance with ASME A112.18.1 or CSA B125.1 or shall be protected against backflow by a device
complying with ASME A112.18.3.
